subject: Applied Calculus

sourceBasis.syllabus: R-2025 Unit I: functions, graphs, new functions, limits, continuity, limits at infinity, derivative, maxima/minima, Mean Value Theorem and effect of derivatives on graph shape.
references: Anton, Bivens & Davis, Calculus: Early Transcendentals (2021)
Ron Larson & David C. Falvo, Calculus: An Applied Approach (2013)
Stewart, Clegg & Watson, Calculus: Early Transcendentals (2019)
Thomas et al., Thomas' Calculus: Early Transcendentals (2018)
Singh, K., Engineering Mathematics Through Applications (2019)

note: Original ACADRIX 1-mark practice questions; not claimed official Anna University questions or verified PYQs.

questions.q: What is a function?
questions.a: A function f:A→B assigns exactly one output in B to each allowed input in A.

questions.q: What is the domain of a function?
questions.a: The set of permitted input values of the function.

questions.q: What is the range of a function?
questions.a: The set of actual output values produced by the function.

questions.q: For a real-valued function, what restriction applies to an even-root radicand?
questions.a: The radicand must be non-negative.

questions.q: What restriction applies to the denominator of a real-valued function?
questions.a: The denominator must not be zero.

questions.q: What restriction applies to the argument of ln(x)?
questions.a: The argument must be positive.

questions.q: What ordered pairs form the graph of y=f(x)?
questions.a: All ordered pairs (x,f(x)) for x in the domain.

questions.q: What transformation is represented by f(x)+k?
questions.a: A vertical shift upward by k units.

questions.q: What transformation is represented by f(x)-k?
questions.a: A vertical shift downward by k units.

questions.q: What transformation is represented by f(x-h)?
questions.a: A horizontal shift to the right by h units.

questions.q: What transformation is represented by f(x+h)?
questions.a: A horizontal shift to the left by h units.

questions.q: What transformation is represented by -f(x)?
questions.a: Reflection of the graph in the x-axis.

questions.q: What transformation is represented by f(-x)?
questions.a: Reflection of the graph in the y-axis.

questions.q: What does lim(x→a) f(x)=L mean?
questions.a: f(x) approaches L as x approaches a.

questions.q: When does a finite two-sided limit exist?
questions.a: When the left-hand and right-hand limits exist and are equal.

questions.q: State lim(x→0) sin x/x.
State lim(x→0) (1−cos x)/x².
State lim(x→0) (eˣ−1)/x.
In the standard trigonometric limits used here, what unit must the angle be measured in?
questions.a: Radians.

questions.q: What is continuity at x=a?
questions.a: f(a) exists, the limit as x→a exists, and that limit equals f(a).

questions.q: Can a function be continuous at a point where f(a) is undefined?
questions.a: No.

questions.q: For a rational function at a point in its domain, what simple method may evaluate a limit?
questions.a: Direct substitution, when it gives a determinate value.

questions.q: Name one algebraic technique used to evaluate an indeterminate limit involving a factorable expression.
questions.a: Factorisation followed by cancellation of a common factor.

questions.q: What technique is commonly used for limits containing a difference of square roots?
questions.a: Rationalisation using the conjugate.

questions.q: For a rational function with equal highest powers in numerator and denominator, what is the limit at infinity?
questions.a: The ratio of the leading coefficients.

questions.q: For a rational function whose numerator degree is lower than its denominator degree, what is the limit as x→±∞?
What is a derivative?
questions.a: The instantaneous rate of change of a function, or the slope of its tangent to a curve.

questions.q: Write the derivative from first principles.
questions.a: f′(x)=lim(h→0)[f(x+h)−f(x)]/h.

questions.q: What is the derivative of xⁿ?
questions.a: nxⁿ⁻¹.

questions.q: What is the derivative of sin x?
questions.a: cos x.

questions.q: What is the derivative of cos x?
questions.a: −sin x.

questions.q: What is the derivative of tan x?
questions.a: sec²x.

questions.q: What is the derivative of eˣ?
questions.a: eˣ.

questions.q: What is the derivative of ln x?
State the product rule for differentiation.
questions.a: (uv)′=u′v+uv′.

questions.q: State the quotient rule for differentiation.
questions.a: (u/v)′=(vu′−uv′)/v².

questions.q: State the chain rule.
questions.a: dF(g(x))/dx=F′(g(x))g′(x).

questions.q: What is a critical point?
questions.a: A point in the domain where f′(x)=0 or f′(x) does not exist.

questions.q: What condition gives a local minimum in the second-derivative test?
questions.a: At a stationary point x=a, f′′(a)>0.

questions.q: What condition gives a local maximum in the second-derivative test?
questions.a: At a stationary point x=a, f′′(a)<0.

questions.q: What does f′′(a)=0 imply in the second-derivative test?
questions.a: The test is inconclusive.

questions.q: State the continuity condition of the Mean Value Theorem.
questions.a: f must be continuous on [a,b].

questions.q: State the differentiability condition of the Mean Value Theorem.
questions.a: f must be differentiable on (a,b).

questions.q: State the conclusion of the Mean Value Theorem.
questions.a: At least one c∈(a,b) satisfies f′(c)=[f(b)−f(a)]/(b−a).

questions.q: What does f′(x)>0 indicate on an interval?
questions.a: The function is increasing on that interval.

questions.q: What does f′(x)<0 indicate on an interval?
questions.a: The function is decreasing on that interval.

questions.q: What does f′′(x)>0 indicate about graph shape?
questions.a: The graph is concave upward.

questions.q: What does f′′(x)<0 indicate about graph shape?
questions.a: The graph is concave downward.

questions.q: What is the slope of the tangent to y=f(x) at x=a?
What does the derivative represent physically?
questions.a: The instantaneous rate of change of the dependent quantity with respect to the independent variable.

questions.q: What is the first step in the usual limit approach when direct substitution gives a determinate value?
questions.a: Use direct substitution.

questions.q: Which derivative is unchanged when differentiating eˣ?
questions.a: eˣ itself.

questions.q: At a stationary point, what equation is solved to find candidate extrema?
What is meant by end behaviour of a function?
questions.a: The behaviour of the function as x approaches the ends of its domain, including ±∞ when applicable.

questions.q: Why are domain restrictions important when analysing a function?
questions.a: They determine which input values are allowed and therefore which points can belong to the graph.
